thread:
maria: Heads-up — after the new routing-policy PR went live this morning, invoice preview shows a +2.3% token delta for a small cohort. Can we triage quickly?

tom: saw that. suspect route fallback to cheaper model is being counted differently in tally service. 

sofia: do we have reproducer? tenant id example?

maria: yes — tenant=acme-qa, window=2026-03-18T09:00Z..10:00Z. I can share query.

raj: copying the SQL I ran: ```
SELECT route_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, COUNT(*) AS reqs
FROM billing_events
WHERE tenant='acme-qa' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-18' AND '2026-03-18 10:00'
GROUP BY route_id;
```

ethan: looks plausible. fallback paths insert events with route_id=null and later enrichment assigns route_id=route:cheap-v2 — that enrichment job runs async and the tally service currently dedupes by request_id + route_id at ingest time. If enrichment arrives later we double-count.

maria: so ordering issue between enrichment and tally-ingest. Do we have watermark / causal guarantees?

tom: tally-ingest expects route metadata attached by proxy. The routing PR added an additional async post-route enrichment to annotate cost-centers for canary tenants. Canary path writes a sidecar event to enrich service, which races.

sofia: cheap fix: let enrichment write to the same Kafka topic with the same key so it gets processed before tally-ingest? But that depends on producer ordering guarantees.

raj: also sampling: we only surface sample=true events to preview dashboard to keep cost down. Canary had sampling disabled for debugging which inflated preview.

ethan: ah — that explains the +2.3%. For acme-qa their requests hit fallback => enrichment disabled sampling flag => all events forwarded and then later enriched, causing transient duplicates in preview aggregator. Production tally dedupe still ok because it waits for enrichment TTL, but preview pipeline is eager.

maria: summary: three contributing factors: routing change (new fallback path), enrichment race, preview pipeline sampling flag. Actionable?

tom: propose: 1) quick rollback of sampling override for preview (hotfix) 2) change preview aggregator to use request_id-only dedupe windowed TTL 3) longer term: move enrichment into sync path or attach cost-center at router.

sofia: agree. I'll open a small PR to remove preview sampling override.

ethan: I'll add a temporary dedupe by request_id in preview aggregator with a 10-min TTL to avoid billing-looking spikes.

raj: I'll add a monitoring card: new metric `preview.dedupe_rate` and `routing.fallback_rate` and alert if preview tokens vs tally tokens diverge > 1.5% over 15m.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for eng-platform/preview-aggregator @tom

maria: thanks team. Can we also add a console annotation explaining that preview can show transient deltas during routing rollouts? Product wants to avoid customer confusion.

tom: good call. I'll add a small banner in Console with the note and link to incident thread.

sofia: PR links: https://git.company/redwood/preview-ux/pulls/412 and https://git.company/redwood/router/pulls/998 (enrichment followup).

ethan: post-deploy checklist: monitor `preview.tokens` vs `tally.tokens` for 30m, post back here.

maria: will do. tagging @support so they can handle any incoming customer questions. :thumbsup:
